preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 50 for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string has a length between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ABC' for c in s) for s in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each string consists only of the characters 'A', 'B', and 'C'.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in ['YES', 'NO'] for output_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((count_A % 2 == count_B % 2 == count_C % 2 == 0) == (output_line == 'YES') for (count_A, count_B, count_C, output_line) in zip(counts_A, counts_B, counts_C, output_lines))
postconditions.description: A string can be fully erased if and only if the counts of 'A', 'B', and 'C' are all even.
